explain.the-hi-vis-line:
What does "hi-vis" mean?

Hi-vis is Australian slang for the bright, high-visibility vests worn on building sites, roads, warehouses and delivery routes (作業用の反射ベスト).

Here it means factory, driving, building, cleaning and packing jobs, compared with managers and professionals. It describes jobs, not people.
